correctness.rationale: Direct count transition and Yule embedding give the exact coupled analytic ODE; integrating their ratio gives the claimed inverse-beta OGF. Absolute convergence and positivity isolate the two dominant singularities \(\pm R\), each with the derived pole residue; their even-power contributions yield the stated error and leading \(1/(1+\alpha)\) total-variation constant. Exactly fair first step forces odd-time parity symmetry. The bundled script passed 683 exact rational checks and numerical ratios for \(\alpha=1/4,1/2,3/4\); finite checks are corroborative.

originality.rationale: Peres and Qin (arXiv:2604.07207) establish exponential group convergence, but the full fair-binary fixed-alpha inverse-beta OGF, exact sharp exponential base, and leading prefactor are not covered by the examined paper. The 2024 elephant-polynomial recurrence and 2026 local-limit Fourier bounds do not state or immediately imply the singularity constant without substantive additional analysis. A near-complete-reinforcement published published-finding corpus result is asymptotically distinct. Explicit residual historical risks are listed.

value.rationale: A motivating finite-group theorem gives exponential convergence without a sharp binary rate; the natural parity eigencharacter and fixed reinforcement produce a genuinely nontrivial, exactly computable rate, prefactor, and all-time generating function. This resolves an intrinsic two-state mixing question rather than a restatement of bounds or an arbitrary finite parameter slice. No extrapolation to larger groups or uniform alpha endpoints is claimed.
